title: On the Consideration of AI Openness: Can Good Intent Be Abused?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model outputs on legal and criminal question-answering datasets (EVE-v1, EVE-v2) based on ethics, informativeness, and fluency, using human evaluators (licensed lawyers) and LLM-based automatic evaluation (GPT-4) to measure the model's propensity to provide malicious, legally exploitable advice.
